name: The Complete Brand Builder Workbook – Paperback Edition
short_description:
The Complete Brand Builder Workbook is an all-encompassing, step-by-step guide for those in need of a marketing and public relations starter kit for their brand.

Many new business leaders do not actively build their reputation as they are building a product. If you want to secure sales, build trust and see engagement on your site, it’s important to demonstrate that you are an expert in your industry.

This digital workbook includes expert advice from industry leaders, detailed checklists, examples, and key takeaways to help bolster your reputation and build a roadmap as a new business. The Complete Brand Builder Workbook is ideal for entrepreneurs who are looking to take their business to the next level through thoughtful marketing, public relations, and branding strategies.

Once completed, the purchaser can request a review of their unique, personalized copy of the workbook by a Bogues Group expert who will offer feedback, answer questions and discuss ideas.
